votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of April 4, 2023 and May 2, 2023.
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from April 4, 2023 and May 2, 2023.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 and B-2 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on two grant applications—one for Urban Forest Management Plan and Canopy Assessment (USDA Forest Service) and one for the Climate Pollution Reduction Program (EPA)—and referred both to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Rezone at approximately 1350, 1358, and 1370 South West Temple).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from RB to TSA-UC-C at 1350, 1358, and 1370 South West Temple Street and deferred action to a future meeting. Councilmember Mano was recused.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Zoning Map and Master Plan Amendments at Riverside Cottages).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed zoning and master plan amendments for properties at 1500, 1516, 1520, 1522 West 500 North and 552 North 1500 West, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Rezone at 1549, 1551, 1565 South 1000 West and 1574 South 900 West).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1/7,000 to RMF-30 for properties on South 1000 West and South 900 West, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Rezone at approximately 510 South 200 West).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from D-2 to D-1 for property at 510 South 200 West and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Ordinance: Nonconforming Signs).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed ordinance amending Title 21A regarding nonconforming signs, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 754 South State Street).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed ordinances to rezone 754 South State Street from D-2 to D-1 and to amend text allowing hospitals and ambulance services as conditional uses in D-1, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Accept the clarification and adopt the ordinance as prepared for this meeting (Downtown Building Height and Street Activation Text Amendment).
votes.description: The Council accepted a clarification and adopted an ordinance correcting street activation language that had been omitted from the version adopted at the June 6, 2023 meeting, relating to Downtown Plan area building height and street activation regulations.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting a Truth-in-Taxation hearing date, a resolution clarifying the Senator Jake Garn Greeting Room name at the airport, a board appointment to the Parks/PNUT Advisory Board, and a library board reappointment.
